capability.name: HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421) verification
capability.description: Verifies the RFC 9421 signatures on an HTTP request or response: rebuilds each signature base from the message you send (derived components, fields, ;req, ;bs, ;key, @query-param), checks it with your key (JWK or PEM: Ed25519, ECDSA P-256 and P-384, RSA-PSS-SHA512, RSA v1.5 SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256), judges created and expires against now, checks Content-Digest against the body, and says what each signature covers and what it leaves out. Returns the signature base it built, so a signer can see where theirs differs. Passes all six RFC 9421 Appendix B examples.

message.description: {method, url, headers, body} or {status, headers, body}

request.description: the request, for a response's ;req components

max_age.description: seconds a signature may be old

note: web bot auth, AID, agent-to-agent requests: does this signed message verify
